## Description

New terms and DPA version stating that Medvya approves the organisation only, does not verify individual doctors, and that the owner is responsible for who they add and for attesting each doctor's licence, including the effect of a false attestation. Bump the terms version so owners re-accept through the existing terms gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Counsel signs off the wording before it is used with a real pilot clinic.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the new version, when an owner signs in, then they must accept it before booking or messaging (existing gate).
- [ ] **AC3.** The attestation step shows a plain-language reminder of this responsibility.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
